en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large European town square labeled 'Altmarkt' with the city name 'Dresden'. The scene shows Dresden's historic Old Market Square filled with pedestrians, horse‑drawn carriages, and early electric trams. Surrounding the square are multi‑story historic buildings with ornate facades, shops, and cafés. A tall church tower rises prominently on the right side, and a large monument with a statue stands in the center of the square.
